criteria: `chunks.py` implements two functions, `chunk(items, size)` and `sliding(items, size, step=1)`; both take a `list` and return a `list` of `list`s, and neither changes its argument.
`chunk(items, size)` cuts the list into consecutive pieces of `size` items; the last piece may be shorter; an empty list gives `[]`.

`sliding(items, size, step=1)` returns every window of exactly `size` consecutive items, starting at positions 0, `step`, `2 * step`, and so on; a window that would run past the end is left out; a list shorter than `size` gives `[]`.
In `chunk` and `sliding`, `size` and `step` must be `int`s of at least 1, otherwise `ValueError` is raised.
The provided tests in test_visible.py pass, with that file unchanged
